issues.title: Ingest Monroe County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $6,581,750 across 17 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($2,434,138), County Road Fund ($2,205,660), ARP Fund ($745,053). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
